data.gender_notes: Felicina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Felicina is derived from the Latin word 'felix', which means 'happy' or 'joyful'. In Christian tradition, the name Felicina is also associated with the virtue of mercy. The name is often given to girls born into happy or blessed families. The name Felicina carries the meaning “Joyful, Happy, Merciful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Latin. Parents who choose Felicina usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, happy, merciful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that brings joy and happiness, and represents the virtue of mercy.

in_hebrew.name: פליצינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פליצינה היא שם שמאופיין בשמחה וחגיגה. השם נגזר מהמילה הלטינית felicitas, שמשמעה שמחה ואושר. בברית החדשה, אין מקורות ישירים לשם זה. אולם, השם נפוץ במאה ה-20 בקרב קהילות נוצריות. בעברית, השם עשוי להתייחס לדברים טובים, אושר, ושמחה. בקרב הנוצרים, השם עשוי להתייחס לאושר של האל, לאושר של הנצרות, או לאושר של החיים.

in_greek.name: Φελιτσίνα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Φελιτσίνα είναι χαρακτηρισμένο από χαρά και εορτασμό. Το όνομα προέρχεται από την λατινική λέξη felicitas, την οποία σημαίνει χαρά και ευτυχία. Στο Παλαιό και Νέο Testament, δεν υπάρχουν σαφείς αναφορές για το όνομα. อย่างไรก็ตาม, το όνομα έγινε δημοφιλές τον 20ο αιώνα μεταξύ των Χριστιανικών κοινωτήτων. Στην Ελληνική γλώσσα, το όνομα μπορεί να αναφέρεται σε καλά πράγματα, ευτυχία, ή χαρά. Στόν Χριστιανισμόν, το όνομα μπορεί να αναφέρεται στην ευτυχία του Θεού, την ευτυχία του Χριστιανισμού, ή την ευτυχία της ζωής.

in_latin.name: Felicina
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Felicinam descriptum est per gaudium et festa. Nomen originem habet a Latina verbis felicitas, quae significat gaudium et felicitas. In Bibliis, non sunt clarae citationes de nomine. Tamen, nomen factum est popularis in saeculo XX inter Christianas communitates. In Latina, nomen potest referre ad bona facta, felicitatem, aut gaudium. In Christianismo, nomen potest referre ad felicitatem Dei, felicitatem Christianorum, aut felicitatem vitae.

in_english.name: Felicina
in_english.long_meaning: The name Felicina is characterized by happiness and celebration. The name originates from the Latin word felicitas, meaning happiness and felicity. In the Bible, there are no direct references to this name. However, the name became popular in the 20th century among Christian communities. In English, the name may refer to good things, happiness, or joy. In Christianity, the name may refer to the joy of God, the joy of Christianity, or the joy of life. The name is associated with positive qualities such as happiness, joy, and celebration. It is also associated with the virtue of felicity, which is the state of being happy and content. In modern times, the name Felicina has gained popularity as a given name for girls, symbolizing the joy and happiness of life.
